verdict: Focus on the grain variant (4342). The headline is a good font but other options would be nice to see. The gradients could fade instead of clean cut. The minimalism is good, but it needs a bit more use of colour accents and an off-white background, and maybe some more subtle grainy gradients.
reference: design/rounds/r3/ref/minimal-collective.md: a reference to take some inspiration from, not to copy blindly.
